scope: Immutable published Omni Gateway lite derivative; default-off SeedVR2 diagnostics and isolated capture/replay tools. No package upgrades, weight downloads or distilled adapter changes. C14 quality remains unproven until controlled GPU trials.
local_network: Optional command-scoped Git proxy http://127.0.0.1:17890; never copied into Runner or Pod.
validation_boundary: Local recipe checks are not Linux image, Harbor, CUDA or generated-media acceptance.
gateway_policy: Pinned reviewed source; later upstream movement requires a new source review, not automatic rebase.
trigger: push on existing branch with [seedvr2-c14] commit marker; only C14 job runs
repeat_build: explicit empty commit via 03-run-build.cmd; same recipe tree and existing branch
manual_dispatch_limitation: At review, workflow file is absent from default main branch. Do not rely on the webpage Run workflow button.
